extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from source-reviewed structure, activity, and Figure 4 evidence; automated framework notes about translation/nucleic-acid context were removed because they came from background/reference text rather than paper-specific direct mechanism assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Nocaviogua A and B are structure-elucidated lipolanthine RiPP natural products with an avionin-containing macrocycle/related opened ring and a long acyl/guanidino fatty-acid moiety; this is structure-class context, not a direct biological mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No target-binding, membrane-disruption, translation-inhibition, or other direct mechanism assay is reported for the new compounds.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Both compounds lacked detectable antibacterial activity under the tested broth microdilution conditions up to 128 µg/mL; this supports a negative phenotype record, not an antimicrobial mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No mechanistic follow-up was reported for the negative antibacterial result.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Compound 1 showed weak cytotoxicity against selected cancer cell lines at 50 µM, while compound 2 showed no obvious cytotoxicity; the paper suggests the bicyclic scaffold may matter for cytotoxic phenotype, but no direct cytotoxic mechanism assay is provided.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Nocaviogua A compared with Nocaviogua B
